name: Gaurav
role: Full-Stack Developer • System Designer • System Architecture
tagline: I don't just write code. I build digital products and experiences.
headline: Building digital products that people remember.
subheadline: I design and develop modern web experiences, SaaS products and conversion-focused interfaces.

about.intro: I am a full-stack engineer and system architect specializing in turning complex business concepts into fluid, high-conversion web applications.
story: Over the past several years, I have architected and deployed SaaS CRM platforms, intelligent real estate workspaces, agency systems, and bespoke digital commerce products.

My philosophy centers on the intersection of deep engineering rigor and thoughtful interaction design. Code is simply the medium—the real product is the speed, clarity, and delight experienced by the person using it.
I prioritize extreme mobile responsiveness, sub-second load times, modular system architectures, and frictionless user journeys that drive real business results.

philosophy.title: System Architecture First
philosophy.description: Before writing a single component, I structure the data flow, schemas, and API contracts to ensure the platform scales effortlessly without tech debt.

philosophy.title: Obsession with Interaction & Motion
philosophy.description: Interfaces should feel alive. Subtle animations, physics-based micro-interactions, and clear visual hierarchy transform static software into an engaging experience.

philosophy.title: Product-Minded Engineering
philosophy.description: Features exist to solve business challenges. Every button, route, and layout choice is optimized for conversion, usability, and speed.

philosophy.title: Zero Bloat, High Performance
philosophy.description: I believe in clean, modern vanilla CSS and well-structured React components over heavy generic utility frameworks and bulky dependencies.

process.name: Understand
process.detail: Deconstruct the core problem, user personas, business objectives, and technical constraints to establish a clear architectural blueprint.

process.name: Design
process.detail: Formulate design systems, typography hierarchy, fluid layouts, and interaction choreographies tailored specifically to the product's identity.

process.name: Build
process.detail: Develop modular full-stack components, robust REST APIs, resilient database schemas, and clean, separated CSS stylesheets.

process.name: Refine
process.detail: Rigorous mobile-first testing across screen widths (360px–1920px), performance profiling, 60fps interaction audits, and accessibility checks.

process.name: Launch
process.detail: Deploy to high-speed global edge infrastructure (Vercel), configure automated webhooks, domain routing, and analytics.
